methodology: Deterministic, phase-balanced selection from exact UTC frame manifests. One frame per date is chosen across waxing/waning phase, solar-depression regime, lunar-altitude band, season, and year. Source fisheye frames are preserved; comparison views are generated separately so pixel metrics never compare incompatible projections. Reference pixels are observations only; renderer controls derive from astronomy, location/climate, semantic weather evidence, and deterministic editorial baselines rather than photographed luminance or color.

sources.cadence: one source frame per minute; published lossless daily videos sampled hourly

sources.license: Per-file free license recorded in the manifest
sources.selection: Depicts Moon (P180=Q405), structured location (P1259), EXIF local capture time, free Commons media

normalization.method: Inverse fisheye resampling into the same altitude/azimuth projection used by Elements, centered on the detected Moon and constrained by computed lunar altitude.
normalization.metricEligibility: Atmospheric global metrics use all normalized frames. Lunar-local metrics require sourceMoonDetection.confidenceZ >= 3.
